name: tags_update
description: Rename, recolor, or set the glyph of a custom project tag or status. Owner/admin only. Pass projectReference from folders_list (any project/folder by name — UI folder irrelevant). Address by name or id from tags_list. At least one of name, color, or icon.

icon.description: Glyph for a custom status. Ignored on a tag.

tag.description: Current tag/status name (preferred) or numeric id from tags_list.
